#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:             video_pipeline
# Required-Start:       $remote_fs $time
# Required-Stop:        $remote_fs $time
# Default-Start:        4 5
# Default-Stop:         0 1 2 3 4 6
# Short-Description:    Video Pipeline service
### END INIT INFO

# Source function library.
. /etc/init.d/functions

set -e

PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
DAEMON=/usr/bin/video_pipeline
WRAPPER="$DAEMON.sh"
DEBUG_DAEMON=/home/root/video_pipeline
PERF_DAEMON=/home/root/perf/video_pipeline
NAME=video_pipeline
DESC="Video Pipeline service"
PIDFILE=/var/run/video_pipeline.pid
SOFTKILL=TERM

export GST_REGISTRY=/home/root/.gstregistrycache

# Optional args parsing
SERVICE_ARGS="${SERVICE_ARGS} --debug --syslog"

if [ -r /etc/default/video_pipeline ]; then
    . /etc/default/video_pipeline

    SERVICE_ARGS="${SERVICE_ARGS}
                    --type=${MODE:-unknown}
                    --width=${WIDTH}
                    --height=${HEIGHT}
                    --framerate=${FRAME_RATE}
                    ${INTERLACED:+--interlaced}
                    ${CODEC:+--${CODEC}}
                    ${BUFFER_FORMAT:+--buffer-format=${BUFFER_FORMAT}}
                    ${PLANE_SEPARATION:+--plane-separation=${PLANE_SEPARATION}}
                    ${BUFFER_STRIDE:+--stride=${BUFFER_STRIDE}}
                    ${LIVE_UPLOAD:+--ipc-sink}
                    ${GENERAL_OPTS}
                    ${NDI_RX_OPTS}
                    "

    case $CODEC in
        h265)
            SERVICE_ARGS="${SERVICE_ARGS} ${H265_OPTS}"
            # Other h265 specific options
        ;;
        h264)
            SERVICE_ARGS="${SERVICE_ARGS} ${H264_OPTS}"
            # Other h264 specific options
        ;;
    esac

fi

waitpid ()
{
  pid=$1
  # Give pid a chance to exit before we restart with a 5s timeout in 1s intervals
  if [ -z "$pid" ]; then
    return
  fi
  timeout=5;
  while [ $timeout -gt 0 ]
  do
    timeout=$(( $timeout-1 ))
    kill -0 $pid 2> /dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
}

case "$1" in
  start)

        # start-stop-daemon doesn't handle wrapper scripts very well
        # check with status instead
        if status $DAEMON; then
            exit 0
        fi
        if [ -e /etc/default/video_pipeline.nostart ]; then
            echo "Refusing to start $DESC:  due to .nostart"
            exit 0
        fi

        case $CODEC in
            h265|h264)
                case $MODE in
                    unknown*)
                        ;;
                    cp*|encode_test|stream_tx*)
                        encode_setup.sh | logger -s -t video_pipeline
                        ;;
                    pb*|decode_test|stream_rx*)
                        decode_setup.sh | logger -s -t video_pipeline
                        ;;
                esac
                ;;
        esac

        echo -n "Starting $DESC: "
        start-stop-daemon -S -b -n "$NAME" \
          -x "$WRAPPER" -- $SERVICE_ARGS
        echo "$NAME done."
        ;;
  stop)
        echo -n "Stopping $DESC: "
        if start-stop-daemon -K -s $SOFTKILL -x "$DAEMON" -n "$NAME"; then
            # stop with SIGINT signal first, then trying "SIGTERM" if DEAMON is still running.
            for i in $(seq 0 20); do
                if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                   sleep 0.1
                else
                   break
                fi
            done
            if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                echo "FORCE-KILLing $DAEMON" | logger -s -t streaming_pl
                start-stop-daemon -K -s TERM -x "$DAEMON" -n "$NAME"
            fi
        else
            # try daemon under debug
            for debug_daemon in "$DEBUG_DAEMON" "$PERF_DAEMON"; do
                if start-stop-daemon -K -s $SOFTKILL -x "$debug_daemon" -p $PIDFILE; then
                    for i in $(seq 0 20); do
                        if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                            sleep 0.1
                        else
                            break
                        fi
                    done
                    if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                        echo "FORCE-KILLing $DAEMON" | logger -s -t streaming_pl
                        start-stop-daemon -K -s TERM -x "$debug_daemon" -p $PIDFILE
                    fi
                fi
            done
        fi
        echo "$NAME done."
        ;;
  status)
        # for the nostart case allow succesful detection
        # based on process name, not full path, to allow running
        # custom versions via GDB
        if [ -e /etc/default/video_pipeline.nostart -o -e "$PERF_DAEMON" ]; then
            status $(basename "$DAEMON")
            if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
                exit 0
            fi
            # if not successful fall to normal mechanism
        fi
        status "$DAEMON"
        exit $?
        ;;
  restart|force-reload)
        echo -n "Restarting $DESC: "
        if start-stop-daemon -K -s $SOFTKILL -x "$DAEMON" -n "$NAME"; then
            # stop with SIGINT signal first, then trying "SIGTERM" if DEAMON is still running.
            for i in $(seq 0 20); do
                if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                    sleep 0.1
                else
                    break
                fi
            done

            if status $(basename "$DAEMON"); then
                start-stop-daemon -K -s TERM -x "$DAEMON" -n "$NAME"
            fi
        fi
        waitpid `cat $PIDFILE`
        start-stop-daemon -S -b -m -p $PIDFILE \
          -x "$DAEMON" -- $SERVICE_ARGS
        echo "$NAME done."
        ;;
  *)
        N=/etc/init.d/$NAME
        echo "Usage: $N {start|stop|status|restart|force-reload}" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

exit 0

#export GST_DEBUG="3,flvmux:1"

# Useful debug options:
#export GST_DEBUG="3,flvmux:1,rtmp*:5"
#export GST_DEBUG="4,flvmux:1,*capsfilter:7,omx*:7,appsrc:6,videoenc*:6,rtmp*:6"
#export GST_DEBUG="4,*capsfilter:6,omx*:7,appsrc:6,videodec*:6"


# Note that gst logs will quickly fill the ramdisk
#export GST_DEBUG_FILE="/home/root/gst_$(date +%H%M%S).log"

# This environment variable is read by the Xilinx gst-omx integration layer
# during enable of the encoder port.
# It adds extra buffers to the encoder output pool
# Currently we are only encoding HD for streaming and can therefore support
# a large number of buffers. For 4K this will need to be config specific.

export GST_REGISTRY=/home/root/.gstregistrycache

    . /etc/default/streaming_pl
    if [ $MODE != "stream_tx_mlsp" -a $MODE != "stream_tx_mlsp_local" -a $MODE != "stream_tx_ndi" ]; then
        [ -r /etc/default/streamkey ] && . /etc/default/streamkey

init_scripts.partition-migrate.sh:
#!/bin/sh

set -e
# Log normal stuff
log() {
    logger -t partition-migrate-service "$@"
    echo "$@"
}

# but force migration onto the boot console
ktrace() {
    log "$@"
    echo "$@" > /dev/kmsg || true
}

if [ ! -e /proc/device-tree/bootloader/partition_migrate ]; then
    log "Partition migrate flag not set..."
    exit 0
fi

flag=$(xxd -l4 -g4 /proc/device-tree/bootloader/partition_migrate | awk '{print $2}')

if [ -z "$flag" ]; then
    log "Partition migrate not requested..."
    exit 0
fi

gate_guard=$(devmem 0xFFE20000 32)
if [ "$((gate_guard))" -ne "$((0xA53A5385))" ]; then
    log "Migrate gate not found..."
    exit 0
fi

gate_flag=$(devmem 0xFFE20004 32)
gate_flag=$((gate_flag | 0x4))
if [ "$((gate_flag))" -eq 0 ]; then
    log "Migrate gate flag not found..."
    exit 0
fi

# Errors after here proceed to the end
set +e

mode=$((flag))
ktrace "Partition migrate mode $mode"

case $mode in
    1)

        # Hmm,... in older versions of petalinux unrelated startup scripts
        # would ensure /tmp was available for their own purposes.  Now
        # those scripts are cleaner and we might find we have no /tmp
        grep -q "tmpfs /var/volatile" /proc/mounts || (ktrace "running read-only-hooks" ; /etc/init.d/read-only-rootfs-hook.sh start)
        [ -d /var/volatile/tmp ] || (ktrace "creating /tmp" ; mkdir -m 1777 -p /var/volatile/tmp)

        ktrace "running /usr/sbin/partition-migrate..."

        # in pl 2022 when serial-port is unavailable sfdisk and some
        # others try to check the terminal status and bork out, but
        # constraining stdout via tee resolves this and allows
        # post-mortem if developers make enough changes to do so
        /usr/sbin/partition-migrate 2>&1 | tee /tmp/migrate.log
        ;;
    *)
        ktrace "Unknown mode"
        ;;
esac

sync

ktrace "Partition migrate ended: code $?"

# Clear the gate (we should reboot)
gate_flag=$(devmem 0xFFE20004 32)
gate_flag=$((gate_flag & ~0x4))
devmem 0xFFE20004 32 ${gate_flag}

sleep 5s
ktrace "Partition migrate failed to terminate..."
# If we have failed to recover just hard-break the gate guard
while true; do
    devmem 0xFFE20000 32 0
done

#!/bin/sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#

### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          module-init-tools
# Required-Start:    
# Required-Stop:     
# Should-Start:      checkroot
# Should-stop:
# Default-Start:     S
# Default-Stop:
# Short-Description: Process /etc/modules.
# Description:       Load the modules listed in /etc/modules.
### END INIT INFO

LOAD_MODULE=modprobe
[ -f /proc/modules ] || exit 0
[ -d /lib/modules/`uname -r` ] || exit 0

# Test if modules.dep exists and has a size greater than zero
if [ ! -s /lib/modules/`uname -r`/modules.dep ]; then
	[ "$VERBOSE" != no ] && echo "Calculating module dependencies ..."
	depmod -a
fi

[ -f /etc/modules ] || [ -d /etc/modules-load.d ] || exit 0
[ -e /sbin/modprobe ] || LOAD_MODULE=insmod

loaded_modules=" "

process_file() {
	file=$1

	(cat $file; echo; ) |
	while read module args
	do
		case "$module" in
			\#*|"") continue ;;
		esac
		[ -n "$(echo $loaded_modules | grep " $module ")" ] && continue
		[ "$VERBOSE" != no ] && echo -n "$module "
		eval "$LOAD_MODULE $module $args >/dev/null 2>&1"
		loaded_modules="${loaded_modules}${module} "
	done
}

[ "$VERBOSE" != no ] && echo -n "Loading modules: "
[ -f /etc/modules ] && process_file /etc/modules

[ -d /etc/modules-load.d ] || exit 0

for f in /etc/modules-load.d/*.conf; do
	process_file $f
done
[ "$VERBOSE" != no ] && echo

exit 0

#!/bin/sh
#
# rcS		Call all S??* scripts in /etc/rcS.d in
#		numerical/alphabetical order.
#
# Version:	@(#)/etc/init.d/rcS  2.76  19-Apr-1999  miquels@cistron.nl
#

PATH=/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
runlevel=S
prevlevel=N
umask 022
export PATH runlevel prevlevel

#	Make sure proc is mounted
#
[ -d "/proc/1" ] || mount /proc

#
#	Source defaults.
#
. /etc/default/rcS

#
#	Trap CTRL-C &c only in this shell so we can interrupt subprocesses.
#
trap ":" INT QUIT TSTP

#
#	Call all parts in order.
#
exec /etc/init.d/rc S
